Name: Everyone is a demon mod - Portrait mod -WIP-
Author: hurcklefalls
Description:
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=5][u][color=#f4f4f4]Basic Info[/color][/u]
[/size]This mod was inspired by Blizzriel's﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2407?tab=description]Monster valley mod[/url]﻿ (Especially Robin and Seb's Portraits and spites). I did not use any content from that mod, but was simply inspired!
This mod does not make the farmer a demon, only the NPCs!
Also adds some special dialogue acknowledging the horns and/or different appearances! 

[size=3]Please remember that this mod is [color=#00ff00][u]Currently a WIP[/u][/color], I will try to upload as fast as I can while trying to avoid burnout!!
Also, I [u]do not plan to draw the winter and beach outfits until I finish all the portraits of all the characters[/u] listed below! 
[/size]
